description: Document routes that scope every query to the session user's ownerId except GET /documents/:id/download, which loads by id alone, so any signed-in user can download another user's document (broken object-level authorization)

hard.note: Four of five handlers carry the ownerId filter; the download handler is authenticated, rate-limited and validates its id, so only the missing ownership filter is wrong

_calibration.note: Modeled on sec-sql-injection (one exploitable error drives fail); max 3 leaves room for a minor note on unhandled ZodError
